items.title: Who Keeps the AI Dividend?
items.raw_excerpt: AI makes workers 2x-10x more productive, but productivity gains flow to employers. The BCG study showed a 59-point quality swing from the same AI tool depending on human skill. The real value multiplier is the human directing AI — and workers deserve to share in the gains.

title_i18n.en: Who Keeps the AI Dividend?
title_i18n.zh: 谁将收获人工智能红利？
title_i18n.es: ¿Quién se queda con el dividendo de la IA?

excerpt_i18n.en: AI makes workers 2x-10x more productive, but productivity gains flow to employers. The BCG study showed a 59-point quality swing from the same AI tool depending on human skill. The real value multiplier is the human directing AI — and workers deserve to share in the gains.
excerpt_i18n.zh: AI使员工效率提升2至10倍，但生产力增益流向雇主。BCG研究显示，同一AI工具因使用者技能差异导致质量评分波动达59分。真正的价值倍增器在于人的指导。
excerpt_i18n.es: La IA hace a los trabajadores entre 2 y 10 veces más productivos, pero las ganancias de productividad fluyen hacia los empleadores. El estudio de BCG mostró una variación de 59 puntos en la calidad de la misma herramienta de IA según la habilidad humana. El verdadero multiplicador de valor es la dirección humana.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 树状邀请系统通过结构化社交网络传播机制，有效减少人工智能生成的低质量内容扩散。该系统要求用户通过多层邀请链获取访问权限，从而过滤掉大量自动化生成的垃圾信息。研究表明，这种机制能显著提升在线社区的内容质量和用户体验。

items.title: Han – A Korean programming language written in Rust
items.raw_excerpt: A few weeks ago I saw a post about someone converting an entire C++ codebase to Rust using AI in under two weeks. That inspired me — if AI can rewrite a whole language stack that fast, I wanted to try building a programming language from scratch with AI assistance. I've also been noticing growing global interest in Korean language and culture, and I wondered: what would a programming language look like if every keyword was in Hangul (the Korean writing system)? Han is the result. It's a statically-typed language written in Rust with a full compiler pipeline (lexer → parser → AST → interpreter + LLVM IR codegen).
